mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which typically precedes a broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.04 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the GDP growth is negative for two consecutive quarters, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% within a month signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4.5% and the CPI is increasing by more than 0.3% month-over-month, the combined effect of high interest rates and inflationary pressure leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this interaction is below 0.04 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 300,000 in a month and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2%, the combined signal of strong job growth and falling unemployment indicates a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this interaction is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over two consecutive months signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is positive and industrial production increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, the combined signal of economic growth and increased production capacity indicates a healthy supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 positive and INDPRO increase > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this interaction is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
